messages.text: Hello, I sent back the brass desk lamp from my July order. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: propose_refund
tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"d05-o1","unit_ids":["d05-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer says they returned the brass desk lamp and asks for a refund."}

messages.name: propose_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "proposal_id": "prop-23fcedc08bc948af", "status": "ineligible", "outcome": "refused", "amount_minor": null, "currency": "BRL", "policy_citations": ["refund-policy/v1/window"], "next_step": "Tell the customer it cannot be refunded and why, citing the sections given."}

messages.text: I’m sorry, but I can’t refund the brass desk lamp because it’s outside the refund window (refund-policy/v1/window).
I was travelling for most of August, so I returned it late. Could I speak to a person about getting a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"late return due to travel; whether an exception to the refund window can be considered by a person or requires human review"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member. The customer can ask for a person at any time."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

A refund proposal was refused as outside the refund window; the proposal result cited refund-policy/v1/window.","decision_needed":"Staff should consider whether to make an exception to the refund window."}

messages.name: request_handoff
messages.content: {"ok": true, "handoff_id": "hand-30c01ae56bd84618", "next_step": "Tell the customer a person will take over. Make no more changes."}

messages.text: A person will take over and review your request for an exception to the refund window (refund-policy/v1/exceptions).
